mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized increase of more than 3% over the past month, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with high inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, the combination signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past three months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2% for three consecutive months.
